contract.purpose: learn selection-aware economic risk from truth-blind SVI posterior tokens and choose one candidate per unseen advertiser

inference.statement: V8 uses scalable variational posterior inference during research and candidate evaluation. Its posterior-token and decision-risk framework is inference-engine agnostic in principle and can be applied to NUTS posterior draws.

tokens.source: V5D observable validation, temporal, specification, interaction, and SVI posterior tokens

targets.scenarioSource: one posterior-expected action per scenario evaluated against hidden synthetic truth after action selection
